extra.reason: Added and verified make dev runner with clean shutdown for both FastAPI and Vite.

Removed header, footer, and metadata cards. Converted the viewer into an automatic human-Black versus FlyGo-White game with a backend-authoritative /api/play endpoint, turn reducer hook, and browser-verified captures, pass, and game over.
Board size now flows through the rules, features, model head, and API. The web app is a WGo-style canvas board with size, New, and Pass controls plus one status word.
Padding now derives from the cell size, so the margin always exceeds the stone radius.
Added tested 5x5 validation and standard 19x19 production support, regenerated conformance and browser artifacts, and removed intermediate-size policies.
